comment: POLGAPH universe, fixed Nov 13, 2026 before any price or result of a gap morning was read. It is the Testing Desk's POL-i2 universe (the 79 Politics series whose frequency in the public series list is daily, weekly or monthly; claude/testing-desk 60e0d2a5, asked as pc_ requests in pull/TESTING_LISTS_BUNDLE) minus the 10 approval, favourability and generic ballot series, which other cards hold out and which carry their own closed read. A change to this list is a new registration. AMENDMENT 5 (Nov 13, 2026): six series dropped because an open card of another desk holds them out from a date before 2026-11-05 (see dropped_amendment_5); 63 series remain. Written before any price or result of this card was read.
